## NSF Arctic Data Center Courses

I teach annual courses for Arctic researchers on data management, reproducible workflows, and scalable computing. Each course has an open, citable course book.

### Scalable and Computationally Reproducible Approaches to Arctic Research

**Role:** Instructor · Mar 2024, Mar 2025

Course books: [2025](https://doi.org/10.18739/A2NK3670P) · [2024](https://doi.org/10.18739/A2C53F33M)

### Reproducible Approaches to Arctic Research Using R

**Role:** Instructor · Feb 2024

Course book: [2024](https://doi.org/10.18739/A2QF8JM4T)

### Fundamentals in Data Management for Qualitative and Quantitative Arctic Research

**Role:** Instructor · Jan 2024, Jan 2025

Course books: [2025](https://doi.org/10.18739/A2TM7232M) · [2024](https://doi.org/10.18739/A2KP7TT0P)
